title: Microphone-to-ADC analog network remains undefined
description: The product source targets a differential microphone and ADC path but explicitly leaves coupling, common mode, gain, bias, headroom, filtering, noise and low-frequency behavior unresolved. The AFE cannot pass schematic readiness without a supported input contract.

evidence.note: Exact analog network is open and needs reference-circuit and bench validation.
Microphone requires >=25 kohm per output; ADC maximum selectable input is 20 kohm per pin, so direct connection remains unapproved.
R3 reviewed this finding; its existing blocker phase and required external/R4 evidence remain open.
R4 preflight reviewed this finding. R4 electrical closure remains blocked; no R5 schematic approval.

Public official evidence and conditional calculations reviewed; closure criterion is not yet satisfied. Current NXP RM Rev 4 / HW Guide Rev 7 access restriction applies to the RT1062 portions. Finding remains blocking, with original history preserved.

evidence.location: section 10, authorized-manual and owner-input closure audit, 2026-09-30
evidence.note: New NXP manuals do not determine IM73A135-to-ADC analog topology. Four identical, worst-case verified mic buffer/bias/filter/ESD/noise/headroom circuits still absent.

evidence.location: section 1, R4-A circuit decision and calculations
evidence.note: Selected four OPA2320AIDGKR dual unity buffers, per-port TPD2E2U06DRLR, symmetric 100-ohm input and 47-ohm/1-nF output filtering, and 10-uF 5% film AC coupling. 20-kohm ADC input setting is typical only: the calculated 0.84-Hz upper high-pass corner at 5% low capacitance is conditional, so worst-case phase/noise and cable/ESD loading plus targeted bench proof remain open.

Original closure wording required targeted bench proof before R4. Schematic-entry electrical bounds remain required by R4; the selected-harness four-channel 96-kHz physical bench sweep stays open with required_by_phase R14 in the project-state R4-A requirement ledger. No electrical criterion was retired.

evidence.location: SBAS892A section 7.5 p.7 and 7.5 pp.8-10; R4-A2 manufacturer check 2026-10-01
evidence.note: 20-kohm ADC input impedance is listed only as typical; 96-kHz decimation response is specified but electrical SNR/current table is at 48 kHz. No minimum ADC impedance or full-temperature 96-kHz noise guarantee was found, so the existing coupling corner cannot be certified. Finding remains open; later bench obligation remains R14.

TI SBAS892A gives selectable ADC impedances as typical and specifies 48-kHz SNR; TI SBAA395B is a four-analog-microphone performance example and SBAU335 Figure 25 shows EVM AC-coupling provisions. No source guarantees this product?s 96-kHz noise/phase. Preserve physical sweep for R14; the Infineon 100-pF/25-kohm mic load and ADC voltage/backfeed electrical proof remain R4-A.

closure_criterion: R4-A: freeze schematic-ready four-channel topology, exact parts/values and prove microphone 25-kohm/100-pF operating load, ADC recommended/absolute input voltage, buffer drive and power-state safety with worst-case calculations. Typical ADC impedance supports nominal response only. Provide adjustable coupling/filter values; measured 96-kHz noise, response, clipping and phase remain open at R14.
